Project 4: airgapllm — IRB / HIPAA-Safe Offline Containerized Local AI Workbench

Suggested GitHub Repo: airgapllm
GitHub One-Liner: Verifiably offline, containerized local LLM workflows with PII redaction, schema-enforced batch extraction, and IRB/HIPAA audit trails in R.
Topics: r-package, privacy, hipaa, irb, local-llm, docker, apptainer, clinical-research

Project Statement

Behavioral, clinical, educational, and medical researchers sit on extraordinarily rich unstructured text—therapy notes, student writing, longitudinal EMA journals, patient narratives—that cannot legally or ethically be sent to external LLM APIs under IRB, HIPAA, or FERPA protocols. While open-weights models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mistral) can run locally on lab workstations or university HPC GPU nodes, configuring air-gapped Docker or Apptainer GPU containers, pinning exact model weights for reproducibility, stripping PII pre-inference, enforcing strict structured outputs across thousands of rows, and producing auditable compliance documentation remains far too technical for most research labs.

airgapllm is a turnkey, privacy-first R workbench for verifiably offline local AI inference. It generates and manages pinned, network-isolated (--network none) local LLM containers via Docker or HPC Apptainer, runs a deterministic pre-inference PII detection and reversible pseudonymization layer in pure R, executes resumable GPU-batched structured extraction directly on R data frames, and writes immutable, PII-free cryptographic audit trails paired with ready-to-paste IRB protocol documentation.

Why Existing R Tools Aren’t Enough

  • Existing local-LLM wrappers (ollamar, rollama) merely call a local HTTP port—they do not enforce network air-gapping, pin container/model digests, generate HPC GPU Apptainer recipes, redact PII pre-inference, checkpoint 50,000-row batches, or generate IRB/HIPAA audit logs.
  • Researchers currently stitch together fragile Python scripts and ad-hoc regexes with zero formal guarantee that outbound network calls are disabled or that runs are reproducible.

Core Architectural Pillars

  1. Air-Gapped Container Lifecycle Manager: Generates reproducible Docker (--network none, GPU passthrough, read-only rootfs) and HPC Apptainer .def configurations for Ollama, llama.cpp, and vLLM, verifying model weight SHA-256 digests and confirming network isolation prior to execution.
  2. Pre-Inference Privacy & PII Engine: Deterministic pure-R PII detector, redactor, and keyed reversible pseudonymizer covering names, emails, phone numbers, dates, MRNs/student IDs, locations, and lab-defined custom dictionaries—with explicit pre-run privacy coverage reports.
  3. Resumable Schema-Enforced Batch Extractor: Processes R data frames into strictly typed JSON/tibbles with automatic schema validation, structured repair retries on malformed generations, SQLite/parquet row-level checkpointing (crash-resumable), and throughput monitoring.
  4. Immutable IRB/HIPAA Audit Trail & Protocol Generator: Logs cryptographic run manifests (container digest, model SHA, prompt hash, decoding seed/temperature, isolation proof, redaction counts—never raw sensitive text) and renders standardized Methods/IRB Data-Security narrative snippets.

v1 Definition of Done

  • Deterministic PII redaction/pseudonymization engine with strong edge-case unit test coverage.
  • Docker (--network none) and HPC GPU Apptainer config generators + pre-flight isolation verifier.
  • Crash-resumable, schema-validated batch extraction engine working cleanly against both local HTTP endpoints and a built-in deterministic offline mock runtime.
  • Immutable JSONL audit logger, IRB boilerplate generator, comprehensive testthat suite, vignettes, and clean R CMD check.

New-Conversation Handoff Block

We are starting a new flagship, CRAN-grade R package in this repository: `airgapllm` — an IRB/HIPAA-safe, verifiably offline, containerized local AI workbench for sensitive research data in R.

Project mission: Enable clinical, behavioral, educational, and health researchers to run reproducible local LLMs on sensitive text without external API leakage:
1. Air-gapped container manager generating pinned Docker (`--network none`, read-only filesystem, GPU options) and HPC GPU Apptainer configs for `Ollama` / `llama.cpp` / `vLLM`, with model-weight SHA digest pinning and isolation pre-flight checks.
2. Pure-R pre-inference PII detection, redaction, and reversible pseudonymization pipeline (names, emails, phones, dates, IDs, custom dictionaries) with redaction summaries.
3. Crash-resumable, schema-enforced batch extraction from R data frames into typed tibbles (strict schema validation, structured retry/repair, disk checkpointing).
4. Immutable PII-free cryptographic audit trail + IRB/Methods data-security boilerplate generator.
5. Full deterministic mock/offline runtime so 100% of `testthat` tests pass cleanly on macOS without a GPU or live container.

Please start by inspecting this repo, proposing the threat/privacy model, modular architecture (`ARCHITECTURE.md`), and phased implementation plan, and then we will build iteratively to full tests, vignettes, and a clean `R CMD check`.
